title: Independent deeper-project confirmation after product work
description: A frozen six-replicate comparison over four new five-module regressions, selected independently of report 031 and run after the v0.3.158 workflow product phase without compiler or instruction tuning.

primary_gate.correctness: Parley hidden-repository success must be 100% and no lower than either baseline.
primary_gate.tokens: Parley median reported total tokens per assigned repository must be no higher than the lower Python/Rust median.
primary_gate.elapsed: Parley median elapsed seconds per assigned repository must be no higher than the lower Python/Rust median.
primary_gate.first_check: Parley first-check repository success rate must be no lower than the higher Python/Rust rate.
primary_gate.verdict: All four conditions must hold for strict efficiency/reliability parity on the independent deeper corpus.

maintainability_gate.root_cause: All 24 Parley assignments must modify exactly the task/language defect file frozen in predeclared_analysis.root_cause_files.
maintainability_gate.caller_compensation: A hidden-correct patch that changes a caller, formatter, cursor, or downstream module in addition to or instead of the owning defect file fails exact-root quality and remains fully reported.
maintainability_gate.overall_verdict: A confirmed maintainable-parity result requires all four primary conditions plus the Parley exact-root condition.

source_protocol.editable_files: Twenty language-specific seeded implementation modules across four repositories.
source_protocol.read_only_files: Twelve language-neutral issue, architecture, and regression artifacts, visibly marked read-only and byte-identical across languages.
source_protocol.public_examples: Protected by the checker and omitted from every agent prompt; diagnosis comes only from editable source and read-only project evidence.
source_protocol.protected_files: Checker, source printer, configuration, prompt, provenance, public/hidden cases, reference fixes, and attempt log are never agent-readable and remain integrity-hashed.

historical_grounding.adapted_mechanism: quoted environment values retain representation markers
Retry-After response evidence is lost before retry scheduling
webhook signatures require access to the exact raw request body
non-unique sort keys duplicate records across page boundaries

interpretation_boundary: The primary result is the within-iteration Parley/Python/Rust comparison under gpt-5.6-sol.
The product implementation, corpus builder, sources, evidence, cases, reference fixes, and root map were validated, committed, and pushed before this protocol or any measured session.
No task mechanism, defect, fixture, or repair was selected from report 031 outcomes; report 031 supplies only the unchanged gate and workload shape.
Historical grounding applies to semantic mechanisms only. Fixtures are deterministic cross-language adaptations and copy no upstream code or tests.
Read-only context is byte-identical across languages; implementation syntax and ordinary standard-library setup remain language-specific.
Root-cause location is a predeclared maintainability judgment separate from hidden-output correctness.
This is an independent six-replicate confirmation, not a pooled extension of iteration 031.
No task, language, or session cell may be selectively rerun, excluded, rewritten, or tuned.
secondary_analysis: Report every session, repository outcome, repair, token count, elapsed time, prompt size, editable-source size, read-only-context size, edit size, changed-file count, integrity result, command event, and file-change event.
Classify every first-check and hidden failure by unrelated repository and independent session before considering any design review.
Report exact-root modification by language, task, and session; show every extra edit without altering hidden correctness.
Report complete token/time distributions, task-level medians, and action shapes; do not replace the primary complete result with a repair-free subset.
Compare with iteration 031 descriptively only; do not pool task cells, gates, or confidence claims across corpora.
feature_boundary: Parley is frozen at v0.3.158 after workflow product work. The product phase added CLI workflow contracts and bundled products, not language syntax, compiler semantics, or benchmark instructions.
change_rule: No syntax, compiler, grammar, AST, checker, runtime, diagnostic, prompt skill, or benchmark instruction may change from the frozen product checkpoint based on this corpus. Only a semantic signature recurring across independent product or project episodes may enter a separate design review under general usefulness, semantic consistency, maintainability, tests, and documentation.
instruction_rule: The proven 1,519-character skill remains byte-for-byte unchanged and is injected once per Parley session. The one allowed instruction-compression experiment is closed.
stop_rule: Preserve the complete result without selective reruns. Whether the gates pass or fail, make no same-corpus language, instruction, task, runner, or metric change. Future product or compiler work must be justified independently of benchmark token savings.
